test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: M, N, L, O, Q and H are sitting in a row. Q and H are in the centre. M and N are at the ends. L is sitting to the immediate left of N. Who is to the right of M?
solution: People: M, N, L, O, Q, and H are sitting in a row. (1) M and N are at the ends. (2) L is sitting to the left of N.
